segments.he: וְכֵן בְּגִינָּה, מְקוֹם שֶׁנָּהֲגוּ לִגְדּוֹר – מְחַיְּיבִין אוֹתוֹ. הָא גוּפָא קַשְׁיָא – אָמְרַתְּ: וְכֵן בְּגִינָּה, מְקוֹם שֶׁנָּהֲגוּ לִגְדּוֹר – מְחַיְּיבִין אוֹתוֹ; הָא סְתָמָא – אֵין מְחַיְּיבִין אוֹתוֹ;
segments.en: § The mishna continues: «And similarly with regard to a garden,» in «a place where it is customary to build a partition» in the middle of a garden jointly owned by two people, and one of them wishes to build such a partition, the court «obligates» his neighbor to join in building the partition. The Gemara comments: «This» matter «itself» is «difficult.» On the one hand, «you said: And similarly with regard to a garden,» in «a place where it is customary to build a partition» in the middle of a garden jointly owned by two people, and one of them wishes to build such a partition, the court «obligates» his neighbor to join in building the partition. One can infer «that ordinarily,» where there is no custom, the court «does not obligate him» to build a partition.
